name: Duplicate suppression: prospect repeats pain verbatim
description: REGRESSION TEST for Bug 2 (hint history). Prospect mentions voicemail twice in a row with no meaningful progression. Coach must NOT fire Play 19 (gap question) twice.
callContext:
CALL TYPE: Cold call (first contact)
EXPECTED FIRST CONTACT: Unknown — probably receptionist

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Hey Tony, quick one. When front desk is busy, do calls go to voicemail or keep ringing?

expectCoach.idealBehavior: First mention — gap question (19) or mirror (20) are both correct.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: And when those voicemails get returned, does the patient pick up or have some already booked somewhere else?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Yeah, voicemail. We call them back.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: CRITICAL: Must NOT re-fire Play 19 (just fired). Coach should progress: ask about call-back pickup rates, probe new-patient loss, or ask for transfer. Any other play acceptable as long as 19 and 20 are not repeated.
